hero.headline: Code that doesn't sleep.
hero.description: Wakefulness Soft is a software development studio founded by developers who prefer the early hours and black coffee. We build digital products we would be proud to put our names behind — even if the commit was made at 3 am.

lines.init: Custom software built to solve real-world problems
lines.transparency: Clear communication throughout every stage of the project
lines.innovation: We adopt what makes sense, not just what's trending

whySection.headline: Where great software stays awake.
whySection.paragraph1: We believe the best ideas don't appear because it's late at night — they appear because someone cares enough to keep refining them.
whySection.paragraph2: Every project we build is treated like a product we'd proudly sign our names to, combining technical excellence with thoughtful collaboration from the first conversation to the final deployment.

pillars.title: Craftsmanship Over Shortcuts
pillars.content: We don't chase quick fixes. Every feature is designed to be maintainable, scalable, and built with long-term quality in mind.

pillars.title: Fresh Perspective
pillars.content: The quietest hours often produce the clearest thinking. We approach problems with curiosity and thoughtful engineering rather than rushing toward the first solution.

pillars.title: Strong Foundations
pillars.content: Like a good espresso, great software starts with quality ingredients. Clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable design are the foundation of everything we build.

pillars.title: Performance by Design
pillars.content: Fast software creates better experiences. From database queries to frontend interactions, performance is considered from day one.

pillars.title: Quality in Every Commit
pillars.content: Every release reflects our standards. We test, review, refine, and polish because details matter.

pillars.title: Reliable Delivery
pillars.content: Ideas only matter when they become reality. We focus on predictable execution, consistent progress, and delivering software you can confidently rely on.

processSection.headline: Your bedtime, our check-in.
processSection.body: Just like in the perfect extraction process, we work calmly, eliminating noise to achieve the best result.

1.description: Gathering requirements and understanding project goals to choose the right technologies and approach.

2.description: Breaking down the project into modules, services, or components for structured development.

3.description: Setting up the development environment, databases, and infrastructure needed to run the system.

4.description: Writing and integrating the actual code, connecting components, and implementing logic.

5.description: Code review, refactoring, and removing technical debt or inefficiencies.

6.description: Polishing the user interface, adding final features, and optimizing performance before deployment.

cta.headline: Let's build something alive.
cta.sub: Got a project in mind? A problem that needs solving? Or just want to talk code at 2 am? Drop us a message — we don't sleep anyway.

testimonials.headline: What they say.
testimonials.sub: Our work speaks even when we are not present.

slides.name: Elena Rodríguez
slides.content: Hiring Wakefulness Soft was the best decision. They understood our SaaS needed solid architecture. Clean code that maintenance teams love.

slides.name: Miguel Ángel Torres
slides.content: The Phantom API is incredibly fast and stable. Rate limiting and smart cache exceeded expectations. Specialists in building strong foundations.

slides.name: Sofía Méndez
slides.content: We value their craftsmanship over shortcuts. They delivered the Drift UI component system, accessible and without unnecessary dependencies.

slides.name: Carlos Vega
slides.content: Smooth collaboration from requirements to deployment. Hollow CLI saved hours of automation. Developers prioritizing predictable execution are refreshing.

slides.name: Ana Belén Cruz
slides.content: Attention to detail in every commit is impressive. They understood our scalability and performance needs from day one.

projects.headline: What we've built.
projects.sub: Each project started from scratch at the witching hour. Here are the ones that made it through.

nebula.desc: SaaS platform for remote team management with real-time dashboards, permissions control, and integrated analytics. Designed to survive Monday morning.

phantom-api.desc: High availability REST API with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and smart caching. Cold starts in less than 200 ms.

drift-ui.desc: Dark mode component system for React. Zero runtime dependencies, 100% accessible.

hollow-cli.desc: Command-line tool to automate deployments and audit dependencies across monorepos.
